prompt.es: Elige la frase que relaciona dos datos con la duda bien formulada.

choices.text: The rise in complaints is caused by the new rules, and nothing else matters.
The rise in complaints is likely to be linked to the new rules, although other factors may matter.
The rise in complaints was linked by the new rules likely.

feedback.es: Likely y may matter mantienen la relación como posible sin afirmar una causa cerrada.

prompt.es: Escribe una crítica (130–250 palabras): dos críticas, relación con duda y alternativa.

answer.text: I read the blog post about mobile phones and marks, and I think it has two important weaknesses. First, it seems to rely on a very small sample: the writer asked only five friends, so the result cannot speak for the whole school. Arguably, this is the main weakness, because five friends are not enough to prove anything. Second, the post is one-sided. It says the solution is to ban phones, but that is a false dilemma, because there are many other options. To some extent, the writer is right: the fall in marks may be linked to phones, and phones are likely to distract some students. However, a link is not proof, and other factors, such as stress or sleep, may account for the trend. A more balanced alternative would be to survey every class and then agree some simple rules, rather than ban everything. In my opinion, that would be fairer and more reasonable for everybody.

A more balanced alternative would be to survey every class and then agree some simple rules, rather than ban everything. In my opinion, that would be fairer and more reasonable for everybody.

Hello, I want to give my view of the post about phones. It seems to ignore a basic problem: the sample is tiny, because the writer asked only five friends. Arguably, that is enough to make the conclusion weak. The post also offers only two choices, ban phones or lose the marks, and that is a false dilemma. To some extent the writer has a point, because the drop in marks is likely to be linked to phones, but it could also be a coincidence, and other factors may account for it. A reasonable alternative would be to survey every class, rather than five friends, and to agree simple rules together. In my opinion, a more balanced post would be clearer and more useful.

origin.text: Publicación del blog del colegio: «Los móviles arruinan las notas. Pregunté a cinco amigos y todos dicen que sus notas bajaron desde que tienen móvil. La solución es prohibirlos.» Escribe una crítica de 130–250 palabras con dos críticas justificadas (muestra pequeña y solución de solo dos opciones), una frase con relación o causa y modal de duda, y una alternativa razonable.

prompt.es: Elige cómo matizar la conclusión del autor sobre la nueva ruta de autobús.

choices.text: The new route caused the rise, and there is no other explanation.
The new route did nothing, and sales rose by chance alone.
The new route may have helped, but other factors could also account for the rise.

feedback.es: La versión matizada admite una posible ayuda y deja abiertas otras explicaciones.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué alternativa propone la locutora.

choices.text: A quiet hour instead of a complete ban.
A complete ban on all music.

feedback.es: La locutora propone una hora de silencio en vez de la prohibición total.

origin.audio: The article makes a fair point about noise. However, it seems to ignore the shop owners' side. A balanced alternative would be a quiet hour, rather than a complete ban.
